title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun Soundtrack Cover
coreRelationships: Large, bold yellow text serves as the primary visual anchor, interacting with and partially obscuring the figures.
The background is sharply divided diagonally between light blue and pink, creating a dynamic color contrast.
Multiple figures are arranged in a dynamic, non-linear fashion, some appearing to stand on or interact with the typography.
Small, scattered paint splatters and scribbled lines are distributed across the composition, unifying the disparate elements.
A framed photographic insert of a single male figure is positioned at the bottom, adding a distinct layer to the collage.
reuseFormula: Recreate the diagonal split background with light blue and pink. Overlay a collage of diverse, youthful figures in dynamic poses. Superimpose a large, bold, condensed yellow sans-serif title with a dark drop shadow, allowing figures to interact with it. Add scattered paint splatters and scribbled lines for texture. Include a smaller, framed photographic element at the bottom.
